component.name: Ramzi
component.summary: Multi-platform app icon simulator and exporter
محاكي ومُصدِّر أيقونات التطبيقات متعدد المنصات

description.p: Ramzi lets developers preview a single source icon on every major platform and game engine — Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, Windows, watchOS, tvOS, Android TV, Godot, Unity and Unreal Engine — adjust its scale and positioning independently per platform, and export perfectly-sized, spec-compliant icon assets for each target.
Ramzi works fully offline: no network calls, no accounts, no telemetry. All projects and exports stay in local storage.
